name: Log4Shell
summary: JNDI lookup in logged strings lets a remote attacker load and run code on servers that log attacker-controlled input.

name: EternalBlue
summary: Crafted SMBv1 packets give remote code execution on unpatched Windows hosts; used by WannaCry to spread.

name: PrintNightmare
summary: The Print Spooler service lets a user install a malicious driver and run code as SYSTEM.

name: Outlook NTLM leak
summary: A crafted reminder makes Outlook connect to an attacker server and send the user's NTLM hash without any click.

name: Equation Editor overflow
summary: A memory corruption bug in the Equation Editor runs code when a user opens a malicious document.

name: BlueKeep
summary: Pre-authentication remote code execution in RDP on older Windows versions.

name: Zerologon
summary: A flaw in Netlogon's cryptography lets an attacker on the network take over a domain controller account.

name: ProxyLogon
summary: Server-side request forgery in Exchange lets an unauthenticated attacker reach the backend; chained for code execution.

name: Shellshock
summary: Bash runs commands appended to function definitions in environment variables, exposed through CGI web scripts.

name: FortiOS path traversal
summary: Path traversal in the SSL VPN portal lets an unauthenticated attacker read system files, including session credentials.

name: Follina
summary: A document can invoke the ms-msdt URL handler to run PowerShell when opened or previewed.

name: MOVEit Transfer SQL injection
summary: SQL injection in the web application allowed data theft and web shell deployment at scale.

name: MSHTML remote code execution
summary: A malicious Office document loads an ActiveX control through MSHTML to run code.

name: PAN-OS GlobalProtect command injection
summary: Command injection in the GlobalProtect feature gives an unauthenticated attacker root code execution on the firewall.

name: Confluence OGNL injection
summary: OGNL injection lets an unauthenticated attacker run code on Confluence Server and Data Center.

name: Citrix ADC path traversal
summary: Directory traversal leads to unauthenticated remote code execution on the appliance.

name: CurveBall
summary: Improper validation of elliptic-curve certificates lets an attacker spoof code-signing and TLS certificates.

name: Dirty COW
summary: A race condition in copy-on-write handling lets a local user write to read-only memory and gain root.

name: PwnKit
summary: Memory corruption in pkexec lets any local user become root on most Linux distributions.

name: Baron Samedit
summary: A heap overflow in sudo's argument parsing lets a local user gain root without being in sudoers.

name: Citrix Bleed
summary: A buffer over-read leaks session tokens, letting an attacker hijack authenticated sessions.

name: Struts Jakarta parser RCE
summary: A crafted Content-Type header triggers OGNL evaluation and remote code execution.

name: Double Kill
summary: A use-after-free in VBScript runs code when a user opens a malicious web page or document.

name: Exchange static validation key
summary: A fixed cryptographic key in the control panel lets an authenticated user run code as SYSTEM.

name: IOS XE web UI privilege escalation
summary: The web UI lets an unauthenticated attacker create a privilege-15 account on the device.

name: vCenter plugin upload
summary: An unauthenticated file upload in a vSphere Client plugin leads to code execution on vCenter.

name: Spring4Shell
summary: Data binding on JDK 9+ lets an attacker write a web shell through crafted request parameters.

name: ProxyNotShell SSRF
summary: Server-side request forgery used together with CVE-2022-41082 for remote code execution.

name: HiveNightmare
summary: Overly permissive access to the SAM and SYSTEM hives lets a local user read credential hashes from shadow copies.

name: Pulse Secure file read
summary: Pre-authentication arbitrary file read on the VPN exposes cached plaintext credentials.
